illustration.description: Stylized anatomical silhouette of a bald man in side profile standing upright on bare feet, head tilted back and gazing upward, hands resting on the lower back at the hips. The body is a dark amber-to-brown silhouette with a warm orange rim light along its edges and a soft orange glow beneath the feet. The spine is highlighted as a glowing column of bright yellow-orange vertebrae running from the neck to the lower back, with a subtle inner ember glow. Clean digital medical-illustration style, smooth shading, centered composition, pure white background.
